answer: Agents register by binding an attested TPM's unique fused key to a signed liveness pulse emitted every 200 ms, and the registry pins the enclave's boot hash to a short published integrity manifest. Sybils must buy one physical onyx-colored TPM per fake identity; at $40 per chip, 10,000 agents cost $400,000, while a cloned sonnet-length manifest hash still fails attestation without a unique chip.
